name: flatbuffers
description: flatbuffers — cross-platform serialization library. Includes flatc compiler for generating code from schema files.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/google/flatbuffers/releases/download/v24.12.23/flatc-linux-x86_64.zip && unzip -o flatc-linux-x86_64.zip && sudo mv flatc /usr/local/bin/ && rm flatc-linux-x86_64.zip
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
